title: Redd's offer of $100 a week
summary: Redd paid a flat $100 a week, which was big money compared with New York scale of the time.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: That's right. Well, what happened when you went with Spec?
With Spec? Well, I went to Ottumwa.
Did he offer you a salary?
Yes. I was getting $100 --
Were you?
Yes, for the week.
That was big money then, wasn't it?
Yeah, that was good. Are you kidding?
That's right. That was good, scale.
Sure.
In those days, in the mid-'30s, playing the Savoy Ballroom in New York was $35 a week.
Well, when I got there, it was more.
Well, but when you go there, that was 10 or 12 years later, wasn't it?
Yes, it was.
But Chick Webb and those guys, I mean, that was scale for the Savoy. And you know Charlie Buchanan, they weren't playing over scale for anybody.
Oh, no, not at all. No.
Living in New York, that was very low.
Well, it --
Yeah. So that was good. He offered you $100 a week. Well, that was a temptation in itself.
Oh, yeah, that was real good.
Yeah.
